content.text: Digital creators in regions where platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-10|stripe]] are unavailable face significant hurdles in automating their commerce operations. Google Apps Script offers a powerful solution for these creators to facilitate seamless digital product delivery without reliance on traditional payment processors. This post dives into how Google Apps Script can streamline your digital commerce operations, ensuring you can deliver products efficiently and effectively.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a scripting platform that allows you to automate processes across Google products and external services. For digital creators, this means you can automate the delivery of digital products after a payment is confirmed, handling [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-github-pages-free-7|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-about-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-guide|Everything About]] from order processing to email notifications. This is crucial in environments where traditional payment gateways are either blocked or unreliable, enabling creators to maintain control over their sales processes and customer interactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this automation is a combination of Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the crypto payment and triggers a webhook that sends the necessary data to your Google Apps Script. The script then checks the payment status, retrieves the product details from a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends the product download link to the customer via email. This entire process can occur in under 30 seconds, ensuring that your customers receive their products promptly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in markets like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms have limitations. By utilizing Google Apps Script alongside a sovereign commerce stack, these creators can set up robust digital stores that operate independently of restrictive payment processors. This architecture empowers them to maintain their revenue streams and customer relationships without dependency on external services.
Streamline your product delivery with Google Apps Script.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The essential components include Google Apps Script, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and a database solution such as Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Google Apps Script acts as the central hub, managing the workflow from payment confirmation to product delivery. NOWPayments enables automated payment verification, while Supabase or Google Sheets securely store order details, allowing you to scale your operations seamlessly as your business grows.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital commerce automation using Google Apps Script, start by setting up your NOWPayments account and integrate it with your site. Next, create a Google Sheets or Supabase database to manage your orders. Write a Google Apps Script that listens for webhooks from NOWPayments, processes the payment information, and sends out emails with download links. Finally, test the entire workflow thoroughly before launching to ensure timely and accurate product delivery.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by integrating a payment processor with a backend script that listens for payment confirmations. When a crypto payment is completed, a webhook sends the transaction details to your script, which then processes the order and sends the download link to the customer, ensuring a seamless experience.
Automate your commerce and take control of your sales process.

Full automation means the store generates revenue while you sleep, processes orders while you travel, and delivers products while you build your next one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys this complete automated pipeline under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents every technical step for creators who prefer to build it themselves. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up your NOWPayments account and configure it for your products. Choose either Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, ensuring it is accessible by your script. Write and test your Google Apps Script to handle payment confirmations and product delivery. Create email templates for delivery notifications and integrate them into your script. Conduct thorough testing of the full workflow to ensure reliability before launching.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated delivery occurs when a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments. A webhook triggers your backend script, which retrieves product information and sends it to the customer via email, ensuring instant access to their purchase.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a user-defined HTTP callback that is triggered by specific events. In this case, when a payment is confirmed, NOWPayments sends an HTTP request to your Google Apps Script, initiating the order fulfillment process.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?
Yes, using Google Apps Script, you can automate the sending of download links once a payment is confirmed. The script processes the payment data and sends the link directly to the customer's email.
What happens if there is a delay in payment confirmation?

Google Apps Script can be configured to handle payment confirmation delays by periodically checking the payment status via the NOWPayments API. This ensures that customers receive their products even if there are temporary issues.
Is there a limit to the number of webhook events I can handle?
Cloudflare Workers can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, providing ample capacity for most digital creators to manage their automated deliveries efficiently.
